definitions.short: Jabbok , a river east of the Jordan
definitions.full: H2999. Yabboq יַבֹּק proper name, of a river (√ probably בקק ; so Thes after Simonis, Samaritan Di) (ה)יבק מַעֲבַר Gen 32:23 (where perhaps connected with אבק = יאבק ); יַבּ ׳נַ֫חַל Deut 2:37 , ׳יַבּ הַנַּחַל 3:16 ; Josh 12:2 , יַבֹּק Num 21:24 (|| אַרְנֹּן , compare Deut 3:16 ; Josh 12:2 ), הַיַּבֹּק Judg 11:13 , 22 (in both || ארנון ); it empties into Jordan from East, in latitude of Shiloh; northern border of Amorites, Num 21:24 (see Di), Judg 11:22 ; in its upper course it runs south to north, hence (west) border of Ammon, Deut 3:16 (compare 2:37 ), Josh 12:2 ; modern Wady Zerqa Bd Pal.181 .
